Celestial Storm

Released August 3, 2018 · 187 cards

Expanded

Celestial Storm is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on August 3, 2018. Its main set has 168 cards, plus 19 secret rares numbered beyond the set (187 in total). It includes 142 Pokémon, 43 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

60 illustrators worked on Celestial Storm. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (30), Ken Sugimori (19), Kagemaru Himeno (10), Mitsuhiro Arita (6), Atsuko Nishida (5), Masakazu Fukuda (5), Ryo Ueda (5), Toyste Beach (4).
